title: Cooling Water Pump

introduction.definition: A cooling water pump circulates large flows of water at moderate head through heat exchangers, condensers and cooling towers. The model shows a horizontal split-case double-suction pump with suction isolation, discharge check and isolation valves and gauges; vertical turbine or axial-flow pumps are used for large intakes.
applications: Refinery and alumina plant cooling-water circuits
key_points: Built from: Horizontal Split Case Pump (module 2); alternatives VT (4) and axial (11)

classification.configuration: Horizontal, axially split, double suction, between bearings
classification.application: Open/closed cooling water circuits, condenser cooling, HVAC chilled/condenser water

introduction.summary: Cooling-water pumps circulate large volumes of water through heat exchangers, condensers and process coolers at moderate head. A horizontally split-case, double-suction pump is a common choice: high flow with low NPSH required, balanced axial thrust, long bearing life with bearings at both ends of the shaft, and the whole rotor can be lifted out after removing the upper casing half without disturbing the piping or motor. Typical installations run duty/standby pumps with check and isolation valves on each.

parts.name: Lower Casing Half (with Nozzles & Feet)
parts.function: Lower half of the axially split casing: carries the suction and discharge nozzles, feet and bearing brackets, so the rotor can be removed without disturbing the piping.
parts.material: Cast iron, ductile iron, cast steel, bronze, duplex.

parts.name: Upper Casing Half (Removable)
parts.function: Removable top half of the casing; lifting it exposes the complete rotor for inspection.
parts.material: As lower half.

parts.name: Double-Suction Impeller
parts.function: Double-suction impeller: liquid enters from both sides, halving eye velocity (lower NPSHr) and balancing axial thrust.
parts.material: Bronze, cast iron, stainless, duplex.

parts.name: Shaft & Sleeves
parts.function: Transmits torque from the coupling to the impeller(s).
parts.material: Carbon steel, 4140 alloy steel, 410/420 or 316 stainless, duplex.

parts.name: Mechanical Seal – Inboard
parts.function: Seals the rotating shaft where it leaves the pressurised casing.
parts.material: Faces: carbon-graphite, silicon carbide, tungsten carbide; metal parts stainless steel; elastomers per fluid.

parts.name: Bearing Housing – Inboard
parts.function: Holds the shaft bearings and oil or grease, and supports the overhung impeller.
parts.material: Cast iron or ductile iron.

parts.name: Radial Bearing – Inboard
parts.function: Carries radial load near the impeller end.
parts.material: Bearing steel.

parts.name: Mechanical Seal – Outboard
parts.function: Seals the rotating shaft where it leaves the pressurised casing.
parts.material: Faces: carbon-graphite, silicon carbide, tungsten carbide; metal parts stainless steel; elastomers per fluid.

parts.name: Bearing Housing – Outboard
parts.function: Holds the shaft bearings and oil or grease, and supports the overhung impeller.
parts.material: Cast iron or ductile iron.

parts.name: Thrust Bearing – Outboard
parts.function: Carries axial hydraulic thrust and locates the shaft axially.
parts.material: Bearing steel; brass or polyamide cages.

parts.name: Flexible Coupling
parts.function: Transmits torque between motor and pump while accommodating small misalignment and allowing separation for maintenance.
parts.material: Steel or cast iron hubs; elastomer or stainless-steel disc elements.

parts.name: Coupling Guard
parts.function: Prevents contact with rotating parts.
parts.material: Steel, aluminium or non-sparking brass for hazardous areas.

parts.name: Electric Motor – Frame & End Shields
parts.function: Encloses the stator and supports the bearings; feet or flange mount the motor to the baseplate or pump.
parts.material: Cast iron or aluminium frame; steel fasteners.

parts.name: Electric Motor – Stator
parts.function: Produces the rotating magnetic field.
parts.material: Silicon electrical steel, copper magnet wire, Class F/H insulation (typical).

parts.name: Electric Motor – Rotor & Shaft
parts.function: Converts the rotating field into shaft torque (squirrel-cage induction rotor).
parts.material: Electrical steel, die-cast aluminium or copper.

parts.name: Electric Motor – Bearings (DE & NDE)
parts.function: Support the motor rotor at drive and non-drive ends.
parts.material: Bearing steel; grease lubricated.

parts.name: Electric Motor – Cooling Fan
parts.function: Draws cooling air over the finned frame.
parts.material: Polymer, aluminium or steel.

parts.name: Electric Motor – Fan Cover
parts.function: Guards the fan and directs air along the fins.
parts.material: Steel or polymer.

parts.name: Baseplate
parts.function: Provides a rigid common mounting for pump and driver, maintains alignment and transfers loads to the foundation.
parts.material: Carbon steel, painted; stainless steel for hygienic or corrosive areas.

parts.name: Suction & Discharge Piping
parts.function: Connects the pump to the system.
parts.material: Carbon steel, stainless steel, ductile iron, HDPE/PVC as appropriate.

parts.name: Suction Isolation, Discharge Check & Isolation Valves
parts.function: Isolation valve, fully open or fully closed.
parts.material: Cast iron, ductile iron, carbon or stainless steel.

parts.name: Suction & Discharge Pressure Gauges
parts.function: Indicates suction or discharge pressure for operation and performance checks.
parts.material: Stainless steel case and wetted parts.

alignment: Align pump and motor shafts with dial indicators or laser after grouting and again after connecting the piping (hot alignment check for hot service).
Target the coupling manufacturer's tolerances; typical practice for 1500–3000 rpm is ≤0.05 mm offset and ≤0.05 mm/100 mm angularity — verify.
Correct soft foot (< 0.05 mm) before final alignment.
piping: Support suction and discharge piping independently so nozzle loads stay within the manufacturer's (or API 610/HI 9.6.2) allowable values.
Provide a straight run of at least 5 pipe diameters ahead of the suction nozzle (ANSI/HI 9.6.6 guidance — verify) and use an eccentric reducer with the flat side up.
Fit isolation valves on both sides, a check valve on the discharge, and pressure gauges at suction and discharge.
Never use the pump as a pipe anchor; use expansion joints with tie rods only when designed for them.
commissioning: Fill and vent the casing; never run dry.
Check rotation direction with the coupling disconnected.
Start against a partly open discharge valve, then open to the duty point; avoid running at shut-off.
Record baseline vibration, bearing temperature, suction and discharge pressure, flow and motor current.

routine.task: Check vibration, seals and bearing temperature.

overhaul.task: Lift upper casing; inspect impeller and wear rings.

Typical applications include power-plant condenser cooling; refinery and alumina plant cooling-water circuits; HVAC condenser water; process cooling loops.

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Cooling Water Pump.
Check vibration, seals and bearing temperature.
Exercise valves.
Lift upper casing; inspect impeller and wear rings.
Watch for fouling and corrosion: lower flow. Common cause: untreated water.
Watch for water hammer: bang on stop. Common cause: fast-closing check valve.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
